blind_spots: dev800 SE ~1.6 points at 0.70; rung-1 single seed is coarse (noise arms measure it)
shared hosts add noise to active seconds
wave-2 availability is detected from trainer --help flags only

compute.cpu_bench: docs/aircraft-exploratory-sweep-v2/cpu-bench.json (timing only, measured after this plan was written)
compute.env: scripts/exploratory_sweep/bootstrap_host.sh: uv venv Python 3.12.13; torch 2.14.1/torchvision 0.29.1 (CPU or cu130 index); requirements-vlm-local.lock --require-hashes; model at pinned revision via the trainer's verifier; payload sha256-verified with no extras
compute.headroom: 25% of cores and memory free per host; ~16 GB RSS counted per arm
compute.hosts: UW via ~/.claude/bin/uwrun; Mac runs only the light driver

fsspec.reason: .venv-detection has no trl/datasets; datasets 5.1.0 requires fsspec<=2026.7.0; W and I were trained under 2026.7.0

compute.pins: every package shared with .venv-detection equals its version

confirmation: later, on native VAL / sealed TEST, under a separate pre-registration that fixes the recipe first

candidate: rung-3 RL unit mean dev800 accuracy over 3 seeds >= best SFT unit (rung-3 SFT track, sftall 3 seeds, SFT controls) + 2.0 points
paired bootstrap (pooled seeds) vs its time-matched control: CI95 lower bound > 0
same vs its examples-matched control: CI95 lower bound > 0
valid fraction not lower than the compared SFT's by more than 1 point
decision_rule.null_result: no RL recipe beats fair SFT under this budget, reported as such
decision_rule.then: each candidate and the best SFT unit assayed once on h_gate_final; reported as is; no re-selection

forbidden_data: native VAL (any read, listing, copy or score)
sealed TEST (any read, listing, copy or score)

matched_control.data: the RL arm's committed prompt ids (endpoint_receipt.json), in order, one SFT update per prompt, cycling

endpoints.T: time-matched: continued to the RL arm's committed active seconds

matched_control.host: the RL arm's host, after it

grpo-W.design: fractional: full LR x G grid (5 x 3) twice = 30 runs; per cell two distinct beta from {0,0.04,0.1}, opposite temperature {0.7,1.0}, opposite screening {off, threshold 0.5}; beta balanced 10/10/10; best of 4,000 seeded candidates by max |corr| of coded factors

lora_capacity.compare: legacy-qv-v1 vs qwen2vl2b-language-seven-r8-v1 (expanded-LoRA v2, approved INIT from W)
lora_capacity.contract_limits: GRPO only with beta 0.04, or SFT; approved INIT only
lora_capacity.gate: host receipt lists trainer feature expanded_lora; refused (never substituted) until then

matrix_wave2.gate: runner launches an arm only on a host whose receipt lists every feature it names (trainer --help)
matrix_wave2.per_feature_rung1: GRPO-W G8 at LR {5e-6, 1e-5}; RFT and augmented SFT at LR {1e-5, 3e-5}; resolution: SFT-W 1e-5 and GRPO-W 1e-5 G8 at 401,408 pixels

comparison.draw: exact multinomial over (win, tie, loss) counts
comparison.kind: paired bootstrap of accuracy difference vs matched SFT control

metrics.valid: completion ended at EOS and parse_label maps it to one of the 100 labels; invalid counts wrong

model.adapter: rank-8 Q/V LoRA (legacy-qv-v1) unless an arm says otherwise

promotion.late_entrants: a unit finishing after its rung's promotion is promoted if its score >= the lowest promoted unit in its track
promotion.requires: every launched arm of the rung finished; FAILED ranks last and is never promoted
promotion.unit_score: dev800 accuracy at the last step endpoint, mean over seeds at rungs 2-3; ties: equal-class accuracy, then valid fraction

rungs.continuation: seed 42 continues its rung-1 run in place at rung 2; every seed continues its rung-2 run at rung 3

splits.all_train: native TRAIN - h_select - h_gate - dev600 - holdout partners (2,329)
splits.dev600: per class, the 6 S rows with the smallest sha256(json[study_id,'dev600',20261018,label,id]); 6 x 100
splits.dev800: h_select (200) + dev600 (600): selection holdout, assayed at every kept endpoint
splits.h_gate_final: freshpool h_gate (200): read once, rung-3 candidates and the best SFT unit only; no selection after
splits.s_train: S - dev600 - within-pool pHash partners (Hamming <= 6) of any holdout (1,424)

task_data_spec.why: W and I control_identity.data_spec_sha256; saved-adapter TRAIN assay refuses another spec; same labels/question/preprocessing as development/data_spec.json
